# `k.core`

The core module needs no import: its declarations are in scope in every file.

| Declaration | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`Angle`](#angle) | An angle: `45deg`. |
| [`Binding`](#binding) | Two-way state: the `@Binding` annotation on a component field, and the type of a custom binding (`docs/design/04-components.md`, "Two-way binding"). |
| [`Bool`](#bool) | A truth value, `true` or `false`. |
| [`Breaking`](#breaking) | Allows a deliberate breaking change to something a lockfile records: `@Breaking("reason")` (`docs/design/01-principles.md`, "Lockfiles"). |
| [`Builder`](#builder) | Makes a struct follow the named-or-chained rule: fields without a default are named arguments of its initializer, the others are chained methods (`docs/design/01-principles.md`). |
| [`Bytes`](#bytes) | An immutable byte sequence with value semantics (`docs/design/33-crypto.md`). |
| [`Classes`](#classes) | A list of class references from a component's `style` block, the type of [`Stylable`](#stylable) props (`docs/design/06-styles.md`). |
| [`ClosedRange`](#closedrange) | The values from `lowerBound` through `upperBound`, written `a...b`; see also [`HalfOpenRange`](#halfopenrange). |
| [`Codable`](#codable) | A type that can be encoded to and decoded from JSON and Protobuf. |
| [`Color`](#color) | A color: `#3B82F6`, a theme token such as `.primary`, or a computed color. |
| [`Comparable`](#comparable) | A type whose values are ordered, so `<`, `<=`, `>` and `>=` apply and collections can be sorted by it. |
| [`ConfigValue`](#configvalue) | A type a `config` field can have: its value is parsed from an environment variable (`docs/design/25-config-and-secrets.md`). |
| [`Copyable`](#copyable) | A struct with a generated `copy(...)` method taking optional named arguments for any subset of its fields: `user.copy(name: "Ana")`. |
| [`Currency`](#currency) | An ISO 4217 currency (`docs/design/34-money.md`). |
| [`Date`](#date) | An instant in time, with millisecond precision (`docs/design/35-time.md`). |
| [`DateStyle`](#datestyle) | How [`Date.formatted`](#date) writes a date. |
| [`Decimal`](#decimal) | An exact decimal number, for rates and amounts that must not round. |
| [`Delete`](#delete) | Marks the `DELETE` handler of an endpoint page (`docs/design/27-endpoint-pages.md`); see also [`Get`](#get), [`Post`](#post), [`Put`](#put) and [`Patch`](#patch). |
| [`Derived`](#derived) | A read-only value computed lazily from reactive values, with no dependency list. |
| [`Double`](#double) | A 64-bit floating-point number. |
| [`Duration`](#duration) | A length of time: `200ms`, `2s`, `10.minutes`, `3.days` (`docs/design/07-themes-and-units.md`, "Number extensions"). |
| [`Effect`](#effect) | A side effect that re-runs when the reactive values it read change (`docs/design/03-reactivity.md`). |
| [`Emits`](#emits) | Declares an event the component fires: `@Emits let changed: Event<Int>`, an [`Event`](#event). |
| [`Endpoint`](#endpoint) | The app's endpoint pages, generated by the compiler: one case per page with HTTP handlers. |
| [`Env`](#env) | The environment variable a `config` field reads: `@Env("PORT")` (`docs/design/25-config-and-secrets.md`). |
| [`Environment`](#environment) | The environments `use … in` rules choose between (`docs/design/23-app-structure.md`, "Environments"). |
| [`Equatable`](#equatable) | A type whose values can be compared with `==` and `!=`. |
| [`Error`](#error) | A type whose values can be thrown: `throws E` requires `E implements Error` (`docs/design/09-errors.md`). |
| [`Event`](#event) | An event a component fires, declared with [`Emits`](#emits): `@Emits let changed: Event<Int>` (`docs/design/04-components.md`, "Events"). |
| [`extend Double`](#extend-double) | Money literals with a fraction: `24.00.usd`. |
| [`extend Int`](#extend-int) | Money literals on whole numbers: `10.eur`, `1500.jpy`. |
| [`Font`](#font) | The `font` token category: a family and a size, used by the `font` property. |
| [`FontSize`](#fontsize) | The `fontSize` token category: a [`Length`](k-validation.md#length) used for the `fontSize` property. |
| [`Get`](#get) | Marks the `GET` handler of an endpoint page (`docs/design/27-endpoint-pages.md`). |
| [`global`](#global) | Refers to a class from global CSS, escaping scoping: `.class(global("btn-primary"))` (`docs/design/06-styles.md`, "Scoping"). |
| [`HalfOpenRange`](#halfopenrange) | The values from `lowerBound` up to but not including `upperBound`, written `a..<b`; see also [`ClosedRange`](#closedrange). |
| [`Hashable`](#hashable) | A type whose values can be keys of a [`Map`](#map) and elements of a [`Set`](#set). |
| [`Inject`](#inject) | Marks a dependency resolved by the compile-time dependency graph (`docs/design/10-services.md`). |
| [`Int`](#int) | A whole number. |
| [`Layout`](#layout) | Wraps a view page, or every view page of the app, in a layout: `@Layout(Dashboard)` (`docs/design/12-routing.md`). |
| [`Length`](#length) | A CSS length: `16px`, `1.5rem`, `50vh`, `1fr` (`docs/design/07-themes-and-units.md`). |
| [`List`](#list) | An ordered collection with value semantics: immutable when declared `let`, mutable when declared `var` (`docs/design/08-types.md`). |
| [`Load`](#load) | Marks an asynchronous [`Derived`](#derived) value loaded before `view` renders (`docs/design/14-async-data.md`). |
| [`LoadState`](#loadstate) | The state of a value that is loaded asynchronously by hand, for code that doesn't use [`Load`](#load) (`docs/design/08-types.md`). |
| [`Map`](#map) | A collection of keys and values with value semantics. |
| [`MediaCondition`](#mediacondition) | A system preference a theme variant can follow: `variant dark matches .prefersDark { … }`. |
| [`Money`](#money) | An exact decimal amount plus a [`Currency`](#currency) (`docs/design/34-money.md`). |
| [`NoLayout`](#nolayout) | Opts a page out of the app's default [`Layout`](#layout) (`docs/design/23-app-structure.md`). |
| [`NumberStyle`](#numberstyle) | How `formatted(as:)` ([`Int.formatted`](#int), [`Double.formatted`](#double), [`Money.formatted`](#money)) writes a number or an amount of money. |
| [`onCleanup`](#oncleanup) | Registers `block` to run before the enclosing [`Effect`](#effect) re-runs and when its component unmounts (`docs/design/03-reactivity.md`). |
| [`Optional`](#optional) | A value that may be absent, written `T?`. |
| [`Page`](#page) | The app's view pages, generated by the compiler: one case per `page` without HTTP handlers, with the page's [`Param`](#param)s as associated values (`docs/design/12-routing.md`, "Navigation"). |
| [`Param`](#param) | A page parameter, parsed from the URL into its type (`docs/design/12-routing.md`). |
| [`Patch`](#patch) | Marks the `PATCH` handler of an endpoint page (`docs/design/27-endpoint-pages.md`); see also [`Get`](#get). |
| [`Percent`](#percent) | A percentage: `50%`, a CSS value and the amount of [`Color.mix`](#color). |
| [`Post`](#post) | Marks the `POST` handler of an endpoint page (`docs/design/27-endpoint-pages.md`); see also [`Get`](#get). |
| [`Prop`](#prop) | Marks a one-way input from the parent component, read-only in the child (`docs/design/04-components.md`). |
| [`Put`](#put) | Marks the `PUT` handler of an endpoint page (`docs/design/27-endpoint-pages.md`); see also [`Get`](#get). |
| [`Radius`](#radius) | The `radius` token category: a [`Length`](k-validation.md#length) used for the `borderRadius` property. |
| [`Rendering`](#rendering) | Sets where pages render, on the `app`: `@Rendering(.client)` (`docs/design/23-app-structure.md`). |
| [`RenderingMode`](#renderingmode) | Where pages render, set with [`Rendering`](#rendering) on the `app` (`docs/design/23-app-structure.md`, "Rendering mode"). |
| [`Result`](#result) | The outcome of a throwing call as a value: `Result.of { try f() }` (`docs/design/09-errors.md`). |
| [`RoundingRule`](#roundingrule) | How [`Money.multiplied(by:rounding:)`](#money) rounds back to the currency's digits. |
| [`Scope`](#scope) | Sets the lifetime of a service: `@Scope(.server)` (`docs/design/10-services.md`, "Scopes"). |
| [`Secret`](#secret) | A value that must not leak (`docs/design/25-config-and-secrets.md`). |
| [`ServiceScope`](#servicescope) | The lifetime of a service instance, set with [`Scope`](#scope) (`docs/design/10-services.md`, "Scopes"). |
| [`Set`](#set) | An unordered collection of distinct elements with value semantics: `Set(["new", "sale"])`. |
| [`SignInPage`](#signinpage) | Names the page the [`k.auth.Authenticated`](k-auth.md#authenticated) guard redirects to, on the `app`: `@SignInPage(.signIn)` (`docs/design/26-auth-and-sessions.md`). |
| [`Slot`](#slot) | Marks content passed in by the parent: [`View`](#view), `View?` or a scoped slot `(T) -> View`. |
| [`Spacing`](#spacing) | The `space` token category: a [`Length`](k-validation.md#length) used for padding, margins and gaps. |
| [`State`](#state) | Marks a mutable reactive value: writing it updates everything that read it (`docs/design/03-reactivity.md`). |
| [`Stream`](#stream) | An asynchronous sequence that is read once, with `for await` (`docs/design/29-server-streaming.md`). |
| [`String`](#string) | Text: an immutable sequence of Unicode scalar values. |
| [`Stylable`](#stylable) | Marks a class hook a parent may style: `@Stylable let container: Classes`, of type [`Classes`](#classes). |
| [`ThemeVariant`](#themevariant) | The app's theme variants, generated by the compiler from its `theme`: `.base` plus one case per `variant` (`docs/design/07-themes-and-units.md`). |
| [`untracked`](#untracked) | Runs `block` without subscribing the enclosing [`Effect`](#effect) or [`Derived`](#derived) value to what it reads (`docs/design/03-reactivity.md`, "Escape hatches"). |
| [`Url`](#url) | An absolute URL. |
| [`View`](#view) | The content of a `view` block, a slot or a scoped slot: elements, components and text (`docs/design/04-components.md`, "Slots"). |
| [`Void`](#void) | The type with exactly one value, returned by functions that return nothing. |

## Angle

```k,ignore
public struct Angle implements Equatable, Comparable, Codable
```

An angle: `45deg`.

**Members**

- `init(degrees: Double)`
  Creates an angle of `degrees`.
- `var degrees: Double`
  The angle in degrees.

## Binding

```k,ignore
public struct Binding<T>
```

Two-way state: the `@Binding` annotation on a component field, and the
type of a custom binding (`docs/design/04-components.md`, "Two-way
binding").

`@Binding var value: Int` makes `value` writable by the child and
requires `bind x` at the call site. `Binding(get: { … }, set: { v => … })`
builds a binding from functions.

**Members**

- `init(get: () -> T, set: (T) -> Void)`
  Creates a binding that reads with `get` and writes with `set`.

  - Parameters:
    - get: returns the current value.
    - set: stores a new value written by the child.

## Bool

```k,ignore
public struct Bool implements Equatable, Hashable, Comparable, Codable, ConfigValue
```

A truth value, `true` or `false`.

The logical operators are the words `and`, `or` and `not`. Comparing a
`Bool` with a literal (`x == true`) is a lint.

## Breaking

```k,ignore
public struct Breaking
```

Allows a deliberate breaking change to something a lockfile records:
`@Breaking("reason")` (`docs/design/01-principles.md`, "Lockfiles").

**Members**

- `init(_ reason: String)`
  States why the change is acceptable.

## Builder

```k,ignore
public struct Builder
```

Makes a struct follow the named-or-chained rule: fields without a
default are named arguments of its initializer, the others are chained
methods (`docs/design/01-principles.md`).

## Bytes

```k,ignore
public struct Bytes implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable
```

An immutable byte sequence with value semantics
(`docs/design/33-crypto.md`). `a + b` concatenates.

**Members**

- `var count: Int`
  The number of bytes.
- `var hex: String`
  The bytes as lowercase hex text.
- `var base64: String`
  The bytes as Base64 text.
- `var utf8Text: String?`
  The bytes decoded as UTF-8; `nil` if they aren't valid UTF-8.
- `static func parse(hex: String) -> Bytes?`
  Parses hex text in either case.

  - Returns: the bytes, or `nil` for an odd length or a character
    that isn't a hex digit.
- `static func parse(base64: String) -> Bytes?`
  Parses Base64 text.

  - Returns: the bytes, or `nil` if `base64` isn't valid Base64.

## Classes

```k,ignore
public struct Classes
```

A list of class references from a component's `style` block, the type of
[`Stylable`](#stylable) props (`docs/design/06-styles.md`).

Every component also has a generated, nested `Classes` enum of its own
classes, which `.class(...)` resolves against.

## ClosedRange

```k,ignore
public struct ClosedRange<T> implements Equatable, Codable where T implements Comparable
```

The values from `lowerBound` through `upperBound`, written `a...b`;
see also [`HalfOpenRange`](#halfopenrange).

**Members**

- `var lowerBound: T`
  The smallest value in the range.
- `var upperBound: T`
  The largest value in the range.
- `func contains(_ value: T) -> Bool`
  Returns `true` if `value` is in the range, bounds included.
- `func map<U>(_ transform: (T) -> U) -> List<U>`
  Returns the values of the range transformed by `transform`, in
  order (for ranges of [`Int`](#int)).

## Codable

```k,ignore
public interface Codable
```

A type that can be encoded to and decoded from JSON and Protobuf.

Structs and enums derive it with `implements Codable` when every field and
payload is `Codable`. Rpc messages, [`Load`](#load) values, job payloads, storage
values and broadcast messages must be `Codable`
(`docs/design/08-types.md`, `docs/design/28-rpc-wire-format.md`).

## Color

```k,ignore
public struct Color implements Equatable, Codable
```

A color: `#3B82F6`, a theme token such as `.primary`, or a computed
color. Computed at compile time where possible, otherwise `color-mix()`
or a custom property (`docs/design/07-themes-and-units.md`, "Colors").

**Members**

- `static func hex(_ text: String) -> Color`
  Returns the color of hex text such as `"#3B82F6"`.
- `static func rgb(_ red: Int, _ green: Int, _ blue: Int) -> Color`
  Returns the color of red, green and blue components, each `0...255`.
- `static let white: Color`
  Opaque white, `#FFFFFF`.
- `static let black: Color`
  Opaque black, `#000000`.
- `static let transparent: Color`
  A fully transparent color.
- `func opacity(_ alpha: Double) -> Color`
  Returns the color with its alpha multiplied by `alpha`
  (`0.0...1.0`).
- `func mix(_ other: Color, _ amount: Percent) -> Color`
  Returns the color with `amount` of `other` mixed in:
  `.primary.mix(.white, 20%)` is the primary color lightened by 20%
  white.

  - Parameters:
    - other: the color mixed in.
    - amount: the share of `other` in the result, the rest being this
      color (CSS `color-mix(in srgb, self, other amount)`).

## Comparable

```k,ignore
public interface Comparable implements Equatable
```

A type whose values are ordered, so `<`, `<=`, `>` and `>=` apply and
collections can be sorted by it.

Numbers, [`String`](#string), [`Date`](#date), [`Duration`](#duration) and [`Money`](#money) (within one
currency) are comparable. Enums and structs don't derive it.

## ConfigValue

```k,ignore
public interface ConfigValue
```

A type a `config` field can have: its value is parsed from an
environment variable (`docs/design/25-config-and-secrets.md`).

Implemented by [`String`](#string), [`Int`](#int), [`Double`](#double), [`Decimal`](#decimal), [`Bool`](#bool),
[`Duration`](#duration), [`Url`](#url), [`k.crypto.Uuid`](k-crypto.md#uuid), [`k.text.EmailAddress`](k-text.md#emailaddress),
enums without payloads, [`List`](#list) and [`Secret`](#secret).

## Copyable

```k,ignore
public interface Copyable
```

A struct with a generated `copy(...)` method taking optional named
arguments for any subset of its fields: `user.copy(name: "Ana")`.

## Currency

```k,ignore
public enum Currency implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable
```

An ISO 4217 currency (`docs/design/34-money.md`). The cases listed here
are those the examples use; every ISO 4217 code is a case.

**Members**

- `case usd`
  US dollar.
- `case eur`
  Euro.
- `case gbp`
  Pound sterling.
- `case jpy`
  Japanese yen.
- `case chf`
  Swiss franc.
- `var code: String`
  The upper-case code, such as `"USD"`.
- `var minorUnitDigits: Int`
  The number of minor-unit digits (2 for USD, 0 for JPY).
- `static func parse(code: String) -> Currency?`
  Parses an upper-case ISO 4217 code such as `"EUR"`.

  - Returns: the currency, or `nil` if `code` isn't a known one.

## Date

```k,ignore
public struct Date implements Equatable, Hashable, Comparable, Codable, ChartScalable
```

An instant in time, with millisecond precision
(`docs/design/35-time.md`).

The current instant comes only from an injected [`k.time.Clock`](k-time.md#clock): there
is no `Date.now`. `date + 3.days` and `date - 2.hours` are dates, and
`a - b` of two dates is a [`Duration`](#duration).

**Members**

- `init(unixSeconds: Int)`
  Creates the instant `unixSeconds` seconds after
  1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.
- `var unixSeconds: Int`
  The seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, rounded down.
- `static func parse(_ text: String) -> Date?`
  Parses an RFC 3339 timestamp (`2026-03-01T09:30:00Z`).

  - Returns: the instant, or `nil` if `text` isn't a timestamp.
- `func formatted(as style: DateStyle, from reference: Date? = nil) -> String`
  Formats the date in the locale in effect.

  - Parameters:
    - style: what to write ([`DateStyle`](#datestyle)).
    - reference: the instant [`DateStyle.relative`](#datestyle) is relative to
      (usually `clock.now`); required for it, ignored otherwise.
  - Returns: the localized text.

## DateStyle

```k,ignore
public enum DateStyle
```

How [`Date.formatted`](#date) writes a date.

**Members**

- `case date`
  The date only.
- `case time`
  The time only.
- `case dateTime`
  The date and the time.
- `case relative`
  Relative to a reference instant: "5 minutes ago", "in 3 days".

## Decimal

```k,ignore
public struct Decimal implements Equatable, Hashable, Comparable, Codable, ConfigValue
```

An exact decimal number, for rates and amounts that must not round.

Literals with a fraction become `Decimal` where a `Decimal` is expected:
`total.multiplied(by: 1.0825, rounding: .halfEven)`.

**Members**

- `static func parse(_ text: String) -> Decimal?`
  Parses a decimal number such as `"19.99"`.

  - Returns: the number, exactly, or `nil` if `text` isn't one.

## Delete

```k,ignore
public struct Delete
```

Marks the `DELETE` handler of an endpoint page

## Derived

```k,ignore
public struct Derived
```

A read-only value computed lazily from reactive values, with no
dependency list. Requires `let`. Writing it, or writing [`State`](#state) while
computing it, is a compile error (`docs/design/03-reactivity.md`).

## Double

```k,ignore
public struct Double implements Equatable, Comparable, Codable, ConfigValue, ChartScalable
```

A 64-bit floating-point number.

**Members**

- `static func parse(_ text: String) -> Double?`
  Parses a decimal number such as `"2.5"`.

  - Returns: the nearest `Double`, or `nil` if `text` isn't a number.
- `func rounded() -> Int`
  Returns the number rounded to the nearest whole number.
- `func formatted(as style: NumberStyle) -> String`
  Formats the number in the locale in effect, as `style` says
  ([`NumberStyle`](#numberstyle)).
- `var seconds: Duration`
  The duration of this many seconds (`0.2.seconds`).
- `var minutes: Duration`
  The duration of this many minutes.
- `var hours: Duration`
  The duration of this many hours.

## Duration

```k,ignore
public struct Duration implements Equatable, Hashable, Comparable, Codable, ConfigValue
```

A length of time: `200ms`, `2s`, `10.minutes`, `3.days`
(`docs/design/07-themes-and-units.md`, "Number extensions").

Durations need no clock; `clock.now + 3.days` is a [`Date`](#date). As a config
value it parses `30s`, `5m`, `2h` and `10.5s`.

**Members**

- `var inSeconds: Int`
  The duration in whole seconds, rounded down.
- `var inMilliseconds: Int`
  The duration in whole milliseconds.

## Effect

```k,ignore
public struct Effect
```

A side effect that re-runs when the reactive values it read change
(`docs/design/03-reactivity.md`). `@Effect(on: [userId])` lists the
dependencies explicitly, and `@Effect(on: [])` runs once after mount. An
effect can't be `throws`.

**Members**

- `let on: List<Dependency>? = nil`
  The explicit dependencies; `nil` tracks what the body reads, and
  `[]` runs the effect once after mount.

## Equatable

```k,ignore
public interface Equatable
```

A type whose values can be compared with `==` and `!=`.

Structs and enums derive it with `implements Equatable`: two values are
equal when every field (or the case and its payload) is equal. Types that
must not be compared, such as [`Secret`](#secret) and [`k.crypto.Mac`](k-crypto.md#mac), don't
implement it, so `==` on them is a compile error.

## Error

```k,ignore
public interface Error
```

A type whose values can be thrown: `throws E` requires `E implements
Error` (`docs/design/09-errors.md`).

Error types are ordinary enums. An error that crosses the wire (an rpc
error, a [`Load`](#load) error) must also be [`Codable`](#codable).

## Event

```k,ignore
public struct Event<T>
```

An event a component fires, declared with [`Emits`](#emits): `@Emits let
changed: Event<Int>` (`docs/design/04-components.md`, "Events").

A parent listens with `.on(changed: handler)`. Only the declaring
component can fire it.

**Members**

- `func emit(_ payload: T)`
  Fires the event with `payload`, calling the parent's handler.

  - Parameter payload: the value delivered; for `Event<Void>` it is
    omitted: `closed.emit()`.

## Font

```k,ignore
public struct Font implements Equatable, Codable
```

The `font` token category: a family and a size, used by the `font`

- `let size: Length`

## global

```k,ignore
public func global(_ name: String) -> Classes
```

Refers to a class from global CSS, escaping scoping:
`.class(global("btn-primary"))` (`docs/design/06-styles.md`, "Scoping").

- Parameter name: the class name as written in the CSS, without the dot.
- Returns: [`Classes`](#classes) holding that one class.

## HalfOpenRange

```k,ignore
public struct HalfOpenRange<T> implements Equatable, Codable where T implements Comparable
```

The values from `lowerBound` up to but not including `upperBound`,
written `a..<b`; see also [`ClosedRange`](#closedrange). A `for` loop over a range of
[`Int`](#int) counts.

**Members**

- `var lowerBound: T`
  The smallest value in the range.
- `var upperBound: T`
  The first value after the range.
- `func contains(_ value: T) -> Bool`
  Returns `true` if `value` is in the range (`upperBound` excluded).
- `func map<U>(_ transform: (T) -> U) -> List<U>`
  Returns the values of the range transformed by `transform`, in
  order (for ranges of [`Int`](#int)).

## Hashable

```k,ignore
public interface Hashable implements Equatable
```

A type whose values can be keys of a [`Map`](#map) and elements of a [`Set`](#set).

Derived with `implements Hashable`, which implies [`Equatable`](#equatable).

## Inject

```k,ignore
public struct Inject
```

Marks a dependency resolved by the compile-time dependency graph
(`docs/design/10-services.md`). Requires `let`. Injected fields are always
private; `public` on one is a compile error (K1303).

## Int

```k,ignore
public struct Int implements Equatable, Hashable, Comparable, Codable, ConfigValue, ChartScalable
```

A whole number.

Arithmetic `+ - * / %` is built in; `/` truncates. Overflow and division
by zero panic in debug and test builds. Number extensions such as
`10.minutes` and `24.usd` are members of `Int` and `Double`.

**Members**

- `static func parse(_ text: String) -> Int?`
  Parses a decimal integer such as `"-42"`.

  - Returns: the number, or `nil` if `text` isn't an integer.
- `func formatted(as style: NumberStyle) -> String`
  Formats the number in the locale in effect, as `style` says
  ([`NumberStyle`](#numberstyle)).
- `var milliseconds: Duration`
  The duration of this many milliseconds.
- `var seconds: Duration`
  The duration of this many seconds.
- `var second: Duration`
  The duration of this many seconds; an alias of `seconds` that
  reads well as `1.second`.
- `var minutes: Duration`
  The duration of this many minutes.
- `var minute: Duration`
  The duration of this many minutes; an alias of `minutes` for
  `1.minute`.
- `var hours: Duration`
  The duration of this many hours.
- `var hour: Duration`
  The duration of this many hours; an alias of `hours` for
  `1.hour`.
- `var days: Duration`
  The duration of this many days.
- `var day: Duration`
  The duration of this many days; an alias of `days` for `1.day`.
- `var weeks: Duration`
  The duration of this many weeks.
- `var week: Duration`
  The duration of this many weeks; an alias of `weeks` for
  `1.week`.
- `var bytes: Int`
  This many bytes, as a byte count.
- `var kilobytes: Int`
  This many kilobytes (1,000 bytes each), as a byte count.
- `var megabytes: Int`
  This many megabytes (1,000,000 bytes each), as a byte count.

## Layout

```k,ignore
public struct Layout
```

Wraps a view page, or every view page of the app, in a layout:
`@Layout(Dashboard)` (`docs/design/12-routing.md`).

**Members**

- `init(_ layout: DeclarationName)`
  Wraps the page in `layout`, named by its type name.

## Length

```k,ignore
public struct Length implements Equatable, Codable
```

A CSS length: `16px`, `1.5rem`, `50vh`, `1fr`
(`docs/design/07-themes-and-units.md`).

Lengths with the same unit fold at compile time (`16px * 2` is `32px`);
mixed units become `calc()`. [`Spacing`](#spacing), [`Radius`](#radius) and [`FontSize`](#fontsize)
are its token categories.

## List

```k,ignore
public struct List<T> implements Codable
```

An ordered collection with value semantics: immutable when declared
`let`, mutable when declared `var` (`docs/design/08-types.md`).

`[a, b]` is a list literal and `[]` an empty one. Inside a repository,
the entity collection supports the same calls and they are translated to
SQL (`docs/design/19-persistence.md`).

**Members**

- `var count: Int`
  The number of elements.
- `var isEmpty: Bool`
  `true` if the list has no elements.
- `var isNotEmpty: Bool`
  `true` if the list has at least one element.
- `var first: T?`
  The first element, or `nil` if the list is empty.
- `var last: T?`
  The last element, or `nil` if the list is empty.
- `func filter(_ predicate: (T) -> Bool) -> List<T>`
  The elements for which `predicate` is `true`.
- `func map<U>(_ transform: (T) -> U) -> List<U>`
  The results of `transform` for each element, in order.
- `func compactMap<U>(_ transform: (T) -> U?) -> List<U>`
  The non-`nil` results of `transform`.
- `func flatMap<U>(_ transform: (T) -> List<U>) -> List<U>`
  The concatenated results of `transform`.
- `func sortedBy<K>(_ key: (T) -> K) -> List<T> where K implements Comparable`
  The elements sorted by `key`, ascending; stable.
- `func sortedByDescending<K>(_ key: (T) -> K) -> List<T> where K implements Comparable`
  The elements sorted by `key`, descending; stable.
- `func thenBy<K>(_ key: (T) -> K) -> List<T> where K implements Comparable`
  Sorts elements that compare equal by the previous sort by `key`,
  ascending; follows `sortedBy` or `sortedByDescending`.
- `func thenByDescending<K>(_ key: (T) -> K) -> List<T> where K implements Comparable`
  Sorts elements that compare equal by the previous sort by `key`,
  descending.
- `func sorted() -> List<T> where T implements Comparable`
  The elements in ascending order.
- `func distinct() -> List<T> where T implements Hashable`
  The elements without repeats, first occurrences kept, in order.
- `func indexWhere(_ predicate: (T) -> Bool) -> Int?`
  The index of the first element for which `predicate` is `true`.
- `func firstWhere(_ predicate: (T) -> Bool) -> T?`
  The first element for which `predicate` is `true`.
- `func any(_ predicate: (T) -> Bool) -> Bool`
  `true` if `predicate` is `true` for some element.
- `func all(_ predicate: (T) -> Bool) -> Bool`
  `true` if `predicate` is `true` for every element.
- `func count(where predicate: (T) -> Bool) -> Int`
  The number of elements for which `predicate` is `true`.
- `func groupedBy<K>(_ key: (T) -> K) -> Map<K, List<T>> where K implements Hashable`
  The elements grouped by `key`.
- `func partitioned(_ predicate: (T) -> Bool) -> (List<T>, List<T>)`
  The elements split into those that match `predicate` and the rest.
- `func chunked(_ size: Int) -> List<List<T>>`
  Consecutive chunks of `size` elements; the last may be shorter.
- `func windowed(_ size: Int) -> List<List<T>>`
  Every run of `size` consecutive elements.
- `func prefix(_ count: Int) -> List<T>`
  The first `count` elements.
- `func minBy<K>(_ key: (T) -> K) -> T? where K implements Comparable`
  The element with the smallest `key`, or `nil` if the list is empty.
- `func maxBy<K>(_ key: (T) -> K) -> T? where K implements Comparable`
  The element with the largest `key`, or `nil` if the list is empty.
- `func sum() -> T`
  The sum of the elements: `0` for an empty `List<Int>` and `0.0` for an
  empty `List<Double>`. Only lists of `Int` or `Double` have it; a list
  of [`Money`](#money) needs a currency and uses `sum(in:_:)` instead
  (`docs/design/34-money.md`). `Int` sums panic on overflow in debug
  and test builds, like `+`.
- `func sum(in currency: Currency, _ amount: (T) -> Money) -> Money`
  The sum of `amount` over the elements, in `currency`; [`Money.zero`](#money) for
  an empty list (`docs/design/34-money.md`).
- `func joined(separator: String) -> String`
  The elements as text, separated by `separator`.
- `func contains(_ element: T) -> Bool where T implements Equatable`
  `true` if `element` is in the list.
- `func contains(where predicate: (T) -> Bool) -> Bool`
  `true` if some element satisfies `predicate`; `contains { … }` reads
  like `any`.
- `func appending(_ other: T) -> List<T>`
  The list followed by the element `other`; the list itself is
  unchanged.
- `func enumerated() -> List<(Int, T)>`
  The pairs of each element and its index.
- `func append(_ element: T)`
  Appends `element`. Requires a `var` list.
- `func insert(_ element: T, at index: Int)`
  Inserts `element` at `index`. Requires a `var` list.
- `func removeWhere(_ predicate: (T) -> Bool)`
  Removes the elements for which `predicate` is `true`. Requires a
  `var` list.
- `func remove(at index: Int) -> T`
  Removes the element at `index` and returns it; panics when `index`
  is out of range. Requires a `var` list.
- `func removeAll()`
  Removes every element. Requires a `var` list.

## Load

```k,ignore
public struct Load
```

Marks an asynchronous [`Derived`](#derived) value loaded before `view` renders
(`docs/design/14-async-data.md`). Requires `let`, a `loading` block and a
[`Codable`](#codable) type; its errors go to the `failed` block.

**Members**

- `let keepOnReload: Bool = false`
  `true` keeps the value on `reload()` while the load's inputs are
  unchanged: for values that don't change on their own, such as a place
  looked up by its id. An input change still runs it again.

## LoadState

```k,ignore
public enum LoadState<T>
```

The state of a value that is loaded asynchronously by hand, for code that
doesn't use [`Load`](#load) (`docs/design/08-types.md`).

**Members**

- `case idle`
  Nothing has been requested yet.
- `case loading`
  A request is in flight.
- `case loaded(T)`
  The value arrived; the payload is the value.
- `case failed(Error)`
  The request failed; the payload is the error.

## Map

```k,ignore
public struct Map<K, V> implements Codable where K implements Hashable
```

A collection of keys and values with value semantics. `[k: v]` is a map
literal and `[:]` an empty one. `map[key]` reads an optional value.

**Members**

- `var count: Int`
  The number of entries.
- `var isEmpty: Bool`
  `true` if the map has no entries.
- `var keys: List<K>`
  The keys, in insertion order.
- `var values: List<V>`
  The values, in insertion order.
- `func get(_ key: K) -> V?`
  Returns the value for `key`, or `nil` if the map has none; the same
  as `map[key]`.
- `func set(_ key: K, _ value: V)`
  Sets the value for `key`, replacing any previous one; a new key goes
  last in insertion order. Requires a `var` map.
- `func remove(_ key: K)`
  Removes the entry for `key`, if any. Requires a `var` map.
- `func containsKey(_ key: K) -> Bool`
  Returns `true` if the map has an entry for `key`.

## MediaCondition

```k,ignore
public enum MediaCondition
```

A system preference a theme variant can follow:
`variant dark matches .prefersDark { … }`.

**Members**

- `case prefersDark`
  The user prefers a dark color scheme (`prefers-color-scheme: dark`).
- `case prefersContrast`
  The user prefers more contrast (`prefers-contrast: more`).
- `case prefersReducedMotion`
  The user prefers reduced motion (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`).

## Money

```k,ignore
public struct Money implements Equatable, Hashable, Comparable, Codable
```

An exact decimal amount plus a [`Currency`](#currency) (`docs/design/34-money.md`).

Literals are number extensions per ISO 4217 code: `24.00.usd`. `+` and
`-` require one currency, and `Money * Int` scales by a quantity.

**Members**

- `init(minorUnits: Int, currency: Currency)`
  Creates an amount from minor units:
  `Money(minorUnits: 2400, currency: .usd)` is `24.00.usd`.
- `var minorUnits: Int`
  The amount in minor units (`24.00.usd` is `2400`); see
  [`Currency.minorUnitDigits`](#currency).
- `var currency: Currency`
  The amount's currency.
- `static func zero(_ currency: Currency) -> Money`
  Returns zero in `currency`.
- `func multiplied(by rate: Decimal, rounding: RoundingRule) -> Money`
  Scales the amount by `rate`, rounded back to the currency's digits.

  - Parameters:
    - rate: the factor, such as a tax rate (`1.0825`).
    - rounding: how a result between two minor units is rounded
      ([`RoundingRule`](#roundingrule)).
  - Returns: the scaled amount, in the same currency.
- `func allocated(into parts: Int) -> List<Money>`
  Splits the amount into `parts` amounts that add up to it exactly;
  panics when `parts` is less than 1.

  - Returns: `parts` amounts in the same currency, differing by at
    most one minor unit.
- `func formatted(as style: NumberStyle) -> String`
  Formats the amount, as `style` says ([`NumberStyle`](#numberstyle));
  [`NumberStyle.currency`](#numberstyle) uses the locale in effect.


How `formatted(as:)` ([`Int.formatted`](#int), [`Double.formatted`](#double),

**Members**

- `case decimal`

- `case wholeNumber`
  Rounded to a whole number.
- `case percent`

- `case currency`
  An amount of money in its own currency, in the locale in effect.

## Optional

```k,ignore

```

A value that may be absent, written `T?`. `nil` is the absent value.

is no force unwrap. Optional types don't nest (`T??` is K0120).

- `case none`
  No value; written `nil`.
- `case some(T)`
  A value.

ones are chained (`.product(id: 42).tab(.reviews)`). Needs no import.

## Result

```k,ignore
public enum Result<T, E> implements Codable where E implements Error
```

The outcome of a throwing call as a value: `Result.of { try f() }`
(`docs/design/09-errors.md`).

**Members**

- `case success(T)`
  The call returned; the payload is its value.
- `case failure(E)`
  The call threw; the payload is its error.
- `static func of(_ block: () throws E -> T) -> Result<T, E>`
  Runs `block` and captures its value or error.

  - Parameter block: the throwing call to run.
  - Returns: `success` with the value `block` returned, or
    `failure` with the error it threw.

## RoundingRule

```k,ignore
public enum RoundingRule
```

How [`Money.multiplied(by:rounding:)`](#money) rounds back to the currency's

- `case halfEven`
  Rounds to the nearest; ties to the even digit (banker's rounding).
- `case halfUp`

- `case down`
  Rounds toward zero.
- `case up`
  Rounds away from zero.

## Secret

```k,ignore
@ServerOnly
public struct Secret<T> implements ConfigValue
```

A value that must not leak (`docs/design/25-config-and-secrets.md`).

`Secret` implements neither [`Codable`](#codable) nor [`Equatable`](#equatable) nor
[`Hashable`](#hashable), so it can't cross the wire or be compared with `==`.
`"{secret}"` interpolates as `Secret(•••)`.

**Members**

- `init(_ value: T)`
  Wraps `value`; used by the runtime and by tests.
- `func reveal() -> T`
  Returns the value, at the one point it is used. Greppable on
  purpose.
- `func matches(_ candidate: T) -> Bool`
  Compares the value with `candidate` in constant time.

  - Returns: `true` if they are equal.

## ServiceScope

```k,ignore

```

The lifetime of a service instance, set with [`Scope`](#scope)
(`docs/design/10-services.md`, "Scopes").

  browser; the default.
- `case request`
  One instance per request; server-only.
- `case route`
  One instance that lives as long as the route is mounted.
- `case component`

- `case server`
  One instance per server process; server-only.

## Set

```k,ignore
public struct Set<T> implements Codable where T implements Hashable
```

An unordered collection of distinct elements with value semantics:
`Set(["new", "sale"])`.

**Members**

- `init(_ elements: List<T>)`
  Creates a set of the distinct elements of `elements`.
- `var count: Int`
  The number of elements.
- `var isEmpty: Bool`
  `true` if the set has no elements.
- `func contains(_ element: T) -> Bool`
  Returns `true` if `element` is in the set.
- `func insert(_ element: T)`
  Adds `element`; does nothing if it is already in the set. Requires

```k,ignore

```

Marks a mutable reactive value: writing it updates everything that read

## Stream

```k,ignore
public struct Stream<T>
```

An asynchronous sequence that is read once, with `for await`
(`docs/design/29-server-streaming.md`).

**Members**

- `func filter(_ predicate: (T) -> Bool) -> Stream<T>`
  Returns a stream of the elements for which `predicate` is `true`,
  computed lazily as they arrive.
- `func map<U>(_ transform: (T) -> U) -> Stream<U>`
  Returns a stream of the results of `transform`, computed lazily.
- `func startingWith(_ value: T) -> Stream<T>`
  Returns a stream that yields `value` first, then the elements of
  this one.
- `func next() async -> T?`
  Waits for the next element.

  - Returns: the element, or `nil` once the stream has ended.

## String

```k,ignore
public struct String implements Equatable, Hashable, Comparable, Codable, ConfigValue
```

Text: an immutable sequence of Unicode scalar values.

String literals are single-line and interpolate with `{ }`:
`"Total: {total}"`. `+` concatenates.

**Members**

- `var count: Int`
  The number of characters.
- `var isEmpty: Bool`
  `true` if the string has no characters.
- `var isNotEmpty: Bool`
  `true` if the string has at least one character.
- `var utf8: Bytes`
  The UTF-8 encoding of the string.
- `func trimmed() -> String`
  Returns the string without leading and trailing whitespace.
- `func lowercased() -> String`
  Returns the string in lower case.
- `func uppercased() -> String`
  Returns the string in upper case.
- `func contains(_ other: String) -> Bool`
  Returns `true` if `other` occurs in the string.
- `func startsWith(_ prefix: String) -> Bool`
  Returns `true` if the string starts with `prefix`.
- `func endsWith(_ suffix: String) -> Bool`
  Returns `true` if the string ends with `suffix`.
- `func split(separator: String, limit: Int? = nil) -> List<String>`
  Splits the string at each occurrence of `separator`.

  - Parameters:
    - separator: the text between parts, not included in them.
    - limit: the most parts to return, the last one holding the rest;
      no limit when `nil`.
  - Returns: the parts, in order.
- `func replace(_ target: String, with replacement: String) -> String`
  Returns the string with every occurrence of `target` replaced by
  `replacement`.
- `func prefix(_ count: Int) -> String`
  Returns the first `count` characters, or the whole string if it is
  shorter.
- `func repeated(times count: Int) -> String`
  Returns the string repeated `count` times.
- `func truncated(length: Int, ending: String = "…") -> String`
  Cuts the string to at most `length` characters, `ending` included
  when it was cut (`"Hello world".truncated(length: 8, ending: "…")`).

  - Returns: the string itself when it is short enough, otherwise its
    start followed by `ending`.

## Url

```k,ignore
public struct Url implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable, ConfigValue
```

An absolute URL. `Url("https://…")` takes a string literal validated at

(`docs/design/32-http-client.md`).

**Members**

- `init(_ literal: String)`
  A URL literal, validated at compile time.
- `var path: String`
  The path, such as `/v1/search`.
- `var host: String`
  The host name, such as `api.example.com`.
- `static func parse(_ text: String) -> Url?`
  Parses runtime text.

  - Returns: the URL, or `nil` if `text` isn't an absolute URL.
- `func appending(path: String) -> Url`
  Returns the URL with `path` joined onto its path.

## View

```k,ignore
public struct View
```

The content of a `view` block, a slot or a scoped slot: elements,
components and text (`docs/design/04-components.md`, "Slots").

Slots are opaque: a `View` can be placed, never inspected.

## Void

```k,ignore
public struct Void implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable
```

The type with exactly one value, returned by functions that return
nothing.

An `Event<Void>` ([`Event`](#event)) is fired with `emit()`, and a job whose
payload is `Void` can run on a schedule. `Void` is `Codable` as `{}`.
